emily: Quick heads-up — I'm doing a short 'gardening' pass over the Optimize toolkit docs around batching, caching, and quant profiles. Found a couple of dead links and one Python snippet that still uses the old SDK call. I'll open a PR (will tag it with the migration checklist) :seedling:

jonathan: Nice — can you paste the files you plan to touch?

emily: Sure, main ones are:
- `docs/optimize/batching.md` (link rot + examples)
- `docs/optimize/kv-cache.md` (two orphan code blocks)
- `docs/optimize/quant-profiles.md` (typo in profile name: `q4_0` -> `q4_0_k`?)

emily: I'll also update the quickstart snippet that shows how to set batching params in the SDK. Current snippet uses the v1 client surface; new one will use `RedwoodClient` and `BatchingConfig`

emily: Example of the replacement snippet I'm drafting:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient, BatchingConfig
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="$REDWOOD_KEY")
config = BatchingConfig(max_tokens=64, max_batch_size=8, burst_delay_ms=10)
resp = client.generate("Summarize: ...", batching=config)
print(resp.text)
```

rita: LGTM — can you also add a short note about when KV prefetch is beneficial vs. prefix caching? Folks keep asking. :+1:

emily: Good call. I'll add a one-paragraph decision tree and a small perf table link.

emily: PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4332 — currently contains the link fixes and the new snippets.

mike: @emily I can sanity-check the Go snippet and run the example in staging. Will comment on the PR today.

emily: Thanks — can you run it against the dedicated staging endpoint? I want to ensure the batching config fields map correctly to the runtime flags.

mike: Yep, will do.

jonathan: Small note — in `quant-profiles.md` we renamed `q4_0_k` earlier; double-check internal name mapping. We accidentally left `q4_k` in the examples.

emily: I found that in `docs/optimize/quant-profiles.md` line ~120. I'll update and add a redirect from the old anchor.

rita: Also, could we add a short "migration checklist" to the PR description so reviewers can tick off tests? Things like: run python example, run go example, verify link redirects, run doc linter.

emily: Yep adding checklist now.

docs-bot: preview site updated for PR #4332 — https://docs-preview.redwood.dev/4332 (may take a minute to warm caches)

emily: Preview looks OK on mobile; the code block formatting needed a tiny tweak.

mike: Ran the Go snippet against staging — only difference I saw was `burst_delay_ms` -> `burst_delay` in the Go client. I'll add a small note and a one-line example in the Go section.

emily: Perfect. If there are no blockers I'll merge by EOD after @rita's checks.

rita: I'll do a quick pass this afternoon. If anything major pops up I'll call it out.

emily: Thanks all — tagging this thread for follow-up. Once merged I'll send a short announcement in #docs with the migration pointers. :tada:
